latestVersion.changelog:
AI Skill Trader v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Scans Polymarket for markets matching a user-defined thesis query.
- Compares user-supplied probability to market price to identify trading opportunities.
- Trades or proposes trades when the edge exceeds a configurable safety threshold.
- Built with the aion-sdk for market reads and trade execution; supports both dry-run and live modes.
- Highly customizable via CLI flags or environment variables for strategy inputs.
- Includes built-in safety checks and tagging for all trades.
